english: Alright, we're back. So talking about furniture, it's very interesting. How do you take it home?
chinese: 好的，我们又回来了。说到家具，很有意思。怎么把它带回家？

english: What do you do? And in this case, they were transporting it themselves.
chinese: 你做什么？在这情况下，他们自己在运送它。

english: And the guy said, I'm going to go home and drop off this nightstand, coffee table and love seat.
chinese: 并且那人说，我要回家把这个夜站、咖啡桌和爱马仕扶手椅送过去。

english: So to drop off.
chinese: 那么就送到。

english: Okay, this is a great verb. To drop off. It's a verbal phrase.
chinese: 好的，这是一个很棒的动词。它是一个口头短语。

english: So the preposition there is off, not on.
chinese: 那么那个介词是off，不是on。

english: Right. So I could say, for example, Marco, I'm just going to drop off my bag at home and then I'll meet you guys for dinner.
chinese: 明白了。比如说，Marco，我就是把包先放在家里的，然后我们一起去吃饭。

english: That means I'm going to go to my house and put down my bag and then I'll leave.
chinese: 这意味着我要回家里放下行李然后就离开。

english: So to drop off is basically to go somewhere so you can put something in that place.
chinese: 所以送交其实就是去某个地方把东西放到那。

english: But it doesn't mean that you're going to go to that place and stay there.
chinese: 但并不意味着你要去那个地方待在那里。

english: So if I say I'm going to drop off the kids at school, that means I'm going to take the kids and leave them at school and then go away.
chinese: 所以我说我要把孩子送到学校，意思是我要带着孩子留下让他们在学校然后我自己离开。

english: It doesn't mean you're going to school yourself.
chinese: 这并不代表你要自己去上学。

english: Right, exactly.
chinese: 明白了。

english: So can you drop off the laundry at the dry cleaners, please?
chinese: 请把洗衣送到干洗店好吗？

english: Very good. So I'm going to take the laundry to the dry cleaners, leave it there and then go somewhere else.
chinese: 非常好。所以我去干洗店拿洗衣物，然后就去别的地方了。

english: So what happens at three o'clock when the kids are still at school?
chinese: 那么三点半的时候，孩子们还在上学吗？

english: That's right. Now we use the opposite verbal phrase and that is to pick up.
chinese: 没错，现在我们用的是反义词表达方式，就是接。

english: Okay, drop off, pick up.
chinese: 好的，送取。

english: So you go pick up the kids, you go pick up the laundry.
chinese: 你去接孩子，你去洗衣服。

english: So this isn't just about picking something up from a table or the ground.
chinese: 这不仅仅是在桌子上或地上拿东西那么简单。

english: You can actually use your car to pick something up.
chinese: 你可以用你的车去拿东西。

english: Right, you go and retrieve it.
chinese: 好的，你去拿吧。

english: So I'm going to the post office to pick up my package.
chinese: 所以我去邮局取包裹。

english: Very good. So phrases that you're going to have to use if you're talking about furniture,
chinese: 非常好。所以你如果在谈论家具时需要用到的短语有：

english: if you're talking about buying something.
chinese: 如果你是在谈论购买东西。

english: And while we're on the topic, I know that one of the most popular places to buy furniture is IKEA.
chinese: 而说到这一点，我知道购买家具最流行的地方之一是宜家。

english: Are you a big fan of IKEA?
chinese: 你是不是宜家的粉丝大粉？

english: I like IKEA and I love what they've done for people who don't want to spend too much money on furniture.
chinese: 我喜欢宜家，我爱他们为不想花太多钱在家具上的人们所做的。

english: Furniture is expensive.
chinese: 家具昂贵。

english: Furniture is very expensive. You can spend $5,000 on a sofa.
chinese: 家具非常昂贵。一张沙发的价格就能花掉5000美元。

english: And so IKEA is a wonderful brand and I think a wonderful company because it makes good looking furniture affordable.
chinese: 而宜家是一个 wonderful 品牌，我认为它也是一家 wonderful 公司，因为它使好看的家具变得 affordable。

english: And it's because you put it together yourself, right?
chinese: 这就是因为你自己把它拼凑起来了，对吧？

english: That's right, a lot of things you have to assemble or put together by yourself.
chinese: 那就是说，很多东西你都要自己组装或拼凑。

english: So you buy it in a box and then you make it.
chinese: 你把它买来放在盒子里，然后自己做出来。

english: And it's a little bit frustrating sometimes.
chinese: 有时候会有点沮丧。

english: But for people like me and I'm sure people like you, it's part of the fun is putting stuff together.
chinese: 但对像我这样的人，以及我相信像你这样的人都知道，把东西组合起来是其中的一部分乐趣。

english: Yeah, because you kind of feel like you kind of built it but you really didn't.
chinese: 是的，因为你感觉你好像建好了，但其实并没有。

english: So it kind of gives you that false sense of accomplishment.
chinese: 所以它会让你产生一种虚假的成就感。

english: It's like I'm in the 19th century and I can make my own furniture.
chinese: 这就像我身处19世纪，可以自己做家具一样。

english: So it's very popular.
chinese: 非常流行。

english: I've actually, apart from having great furniture, I understand that they have amazing meatballs.
chinese: 实际上，除了有很棒的家具外，我还认识到他们有着 amazing 的肉丸。

english: They do.
chinese: 他们如此。

english: Well, I'm Swedish. I never get to eat Swedish meatballs and here in China they do have some of the better meatballs around.
chinese: 嗯，我是瑞典人。从来吃不到瑞典肉丸，不过在中国还是能吃到相当不错的肉丸。

english: So I would recommend if you haven't tried them. Try them. They're pretty good.
chinese: 所以我觉得你们如果没有尝试过的话，不妨试试看。他们挺好的。

english: Yeah, good idea.
chinese: 好的，有道理。

english: Good idea. Have some dinner.
chinese: 好主意。吃点东西吧。

english: Let me know. Our website is englispa.com. Do you like IKEA and do you love their meatballs?
chinese: 告诉我吧，我们的网站是englispa.com。你喜欢IKEA，他们的肉丸好吃吗？

english: All right, we'll see you guys there. Bye.
chinese: 好的，我们到时候见。拜拜。

english: Bye.
chinese: 再见。
